value.rationale: The exact all-parameter Myhill–Nerode index of modular scattered 0^d1 counting is a natural formal-language invariant with sharp prime-adic jumps. It clarifies when the straightforward counter automaton is already optimal and relates frequency-counting representations to minimal recognizers without a table-recomputation or routine substitution.
